decisions.reason: The hypothesis is an actual no-breakdown Arnoldi run, not merely the displayed matrix identity. The cited Arnoldi theorem proof 1.1 explicitly proves w_j orthogonal to v_1,...,v_j and v_(j+1)=w_j/||w_j||. Taking j=m gives V_m^*v_(m+1)=0 without requiring step m+1 to run. Equivalently, its defining residual is w_m=(I-V_m V_m^*)Av_m. Together with unitarity of Q, this proves both summands of g orthogonal to the retained columns. The supplier Statement lists only m-vector orthonormality, but its complete argument and actual process hypothesis supply precisely the property used in step 4.1.
